description: Monthly business performance observations for ~150 businesses across 18 months, designed for competitive intelligence analysis in the Hyderabad cafe market.
generated_from: Seeded from real Hyderabad cafe data (v1_leaders_vs_challengers.csv) with simulated expansion.

columns.description: Unique business identifier (BIZ_001 to BIZ_150)
columns.analytical_purpose: Primary key for joins and grouping

columns.description: Name of the business
columns.source: 11 real names from seed CSV, remainder generated

columns.description: Business type (Cafe, Coffee Shop, Bakery & Cafe, Restaurant & Cafe, Tea House)
columns.transformation: Normalized to standard vocabulary during cleaning

columns.description: Neighborhood/area name within Hyderabad
Geographic cluster (Central, East, West, South, Old City)
Geographic latitude coordinate
columns.source: Generated around real cluster centers with jitter

columns.description: Geographic longitude coordinate
columns.source: Generated around real cluster centers with jitter

columns.description: Price tier (1=Budget, 2=Moderate, 3=Upscale, 4=Premium)
Years the business has been operating (increases monthly)
columns.source: 11 real values from seed, remainder from log-normal distribution

columns.description: Whether this is the user's own business (Cafe Niloufer = true)
First day of the observation month (YYYY-MM-DD)
columns.source: Generated monthly from Jan 2025 to Jun 2026
columns.analytical_purpose: Time series, trend analysis, period filtering

columns.description: Average customer rating for this month (1.0-5.0 scale)

columns.description: Cumulative total review count as of this month

columns.source: Derived from review velocity + seasonality + noise

columns.description: Average hours to respond to customer reviews

columns.transformation: Missing values imputed with per-business median
